relationships.subject: CCI-ION
relationships.evidence_quote: The level of glutamate immunostaining in the SGCs that envelop neurons of all sizes in the TG was significantly higher in rats with CCI-ION than in control rats

relationships.subject: ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of ionomycin, ATP and Bz-ATP induced an increase of extracellular glutamate concentration in cultured trigeminal SGCs, indicating a release of glutamate from SGCs.

key_findings: Glutamate immunogold density rose in trigeminal SGCs and neurons of all sizes after CCI-ION.
Cultured trigeminal SGCs released glutamate in response to ionomycin, ATP and Bz-ATP; SGCs of neighboring nociceptive and mechanosensitive neurons were closely apposed.
